June 3, 2018 - By Jacob Smith
Zeke Ashton increased its stake in Brown & Brown Inc (BRO) by 560% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Centaur Capital Partners Lp bought 140,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.20% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Zeke Ashton held 165,000 shares of the finance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.20M, up from 25,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Centaur Capital Partners Lp who had been investing in Brown & Brown Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.74B market cap company. The stock increased 0.94% or $0.26 during the last trading session, reaching $28.04. About 955,738 shares traded. Brown & Brown, Inc. (NYSE:BRO) has risen 29.47% since June 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.90% the S&P500.
Augustine Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Gilead Sciences Inc (Gild) (GILD) by 21.61% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC.
